review:
A bright cluster-pays fruit game where every winning cluster can leave a wild behind – starting at 2x and doubling on later tumbles up to 256x. Several wilds in a cluster add together.

Three to seven scatters start 10 to 25 free spins, where random wild multipliers start at 3x and can climb to 729x, and three scatters add five spins. 96.53% RTP. Fast, fun and full of building multipliers.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
